question: to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) Subject:
Frontex’s aerial observation of the maritime emergency on 11 May 2026

On 11 May 2026, Frontex observed, including by using a long-range drone, a maritime emergency around 55 nautical miles north of Tripoli, during which the Sea-Watch 5 rescued 90 people from a vessel in distress. Heron 1 departed from Malta but flew back to Valletta before Libyan gunmen fired at the rescue vessel. It is also unclear how Frontex became aware about the maritime emergency. 1.
How did Frontex become aware of the maritime emergency? Which Frontex aircraft then provided information, including any satellite data?

In which Frontex structures or operations were these units deployed, especially if this took place under Joint Operation Italy 2026, Eurosur, Multipurpose Aerial Surveillance or Frontex Aerial Surveillance?
To the best of Frontex’s knowledge, which other vessels or aircraft from neighbouring third countries, such as Libya, were involved in the observing or monitoring the incident?
